_comment: Persian-to-Persian corrections applied after machine translation.
The model is consistent about its mistakes, so a short list fixes most of
them. Entries are matched on whole words only: 'همکار' will not match
inside 'همکاری'. Longer entries are applied before shorter ones, so a
phrase wins over a single word it contains.
Add an entry whenever a wrong rendering shows up more than once. Keep the
note - it is what lets the next person judge whether the rule still holds.

terms.note: 'starve the ego' - the model read the object as the listener
'your partner' - a relationship, not a workplace
